title: Keto Ground Beef Stroganoff
description: This makes a total of 4 servings of Keto Ground Beef Stroganoff. Each serving comes out to be 504 calories, 42.5g fats, 6.3g net carbs, and 23.2g protein.

instructions.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat then add the butter. Once the butter has melted and stops foaming, add the minced garlic. Cook the garlic by stirring frequently until it’s fragrant, then add the ground beef. Season with salt and pepper.
Continue cooking the ground beef and break up the grounds with a wooden spoon. Transfer the cooked beef to a bowl and set aside.
Turn the heat back up to medium. Add the mushrooms to the pan. Continue cooking until the mushrooms are tender. Set the mushrooms aside.
Turn the heat down to low then whisk the sour cream and paprika into the skillet. Add the cooked beef and mushrooms back into the pan and stir together.
Mix in the lemon juice and parsley.
Serve with a sprinkle of paprika over the top.

video.name: Keto Ground Beef Stroganoff Recipe
video.description:
Classic beef stroganoff serves cubes of beef in a creamy sauce, served over rice or noodles. This ketofied version of the recipe also cuts down on its cost, by making use of ground beef. This ground beef stroganoff dinner is easy to make, and a wonderful tool to have for a quick family dinner.

Read the full recipe with full nutrition breakdown and step-by-step pictures over at:

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ingredients:
2 tablespoon butter
1 clove minced garlic
1 pound 80% lean ground beef
Salt and pepper, to taste
10 ounces sliced mushrooms
2 tablespoon water
1 ¼ cup sour cream
½ teaspoon paprika
1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice
1 tablespoon fresh chopped parsley

Nutrition Summary:
This makes a total of 4 servings of Keto Ground Beef Stroganoff. Each serving comes out to be 476.8 Calories, 33.75g Fats, 6g Net Carbs, and 35.75g Protein.
